description: Source code for the UpdateProcessor class in Drupal, handling project update fetching, processing, and XML parsing.

classes.name: UpdateProcessor
classes.description: Handles project update data fetching, processing, and XML parsing within Drupal.

methods.name: createFetchTask
methods.description: Creates a fetch task for a given project if not already queued.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Processes queued fetch tasks within a timeout period.

methods.name: processFetchTask
methods.description: Fetches and processes project data, updates store, and handles failures.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses XML data of release history into an array.

methods.name: numberOfQueueItems
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the fetch queue.

methods.name: claimQueueItem
methods.description: Claims an item from the fetch queue.

methods.name: deleteQueueItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified item from the fetch queue.
